```{r}
df <- read_csv("data/processed_grid.csv")
```

## Fire Severity Feature

```{r}
ifph_inform %>% 
    group_by(is_inform, is_ifph) %>%
    summarize(n=n())

ifph_inform %>%
    group_by(Fire.Mgmt.Complexity, Incident.Type.Category) %>%
    summarize(
        n=n(),
        avg_acres = mean(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(avg_acres)

ifph_inform %>%
    group_by(is_inform) %>%
    summarize(
        n=n(),
        avg_acres = mean(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(avg_acres)

ifph_inform %>%
    group_by(Incident.Type.Category) %>%
    summarize(
        n=n()
    ) %>%
    arrange(n)
```

```{r}
ifph_inform %>%
    group_by(Fire.Mgmt.Complexity, Incident.Type.Category) %>%
    summarize(
        n=n(),
        avg_acres = mean(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE),
        max_acres = max(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE),
        min_acres = min(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(avg_acres) %>%
    print(width=Inf)

ifph_inform %>%
    group_by(is_inform) %>%
    summarize(
        n=n(),
        avg_acres = mean(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE),
        max_acres = max(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE),
        median_acres = median(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE),
        min_acres = min(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(avg_acres) %>%
    print(width=Inf)
```
